convert_model_to_MOLE_model: convert a PyTorch model to a MOLE model by replacing linear layers with MOLE expert layers
replace_linear_with_MOLE: replace a PyTorch linear layer with a MOLE or MOLEDGL expert mixing layer
recursive_replace_so2_linear: recursively replace all SO2 convolution linear layers in a model with a replacement factory
model_search_and_replace: search model blocks and replace modules using a specified search function and replacement factory
MOLEInterface: implement the MOLE interface with methods for setting coefficients, sizes, logging stats, and merging models
